title.narrative: 24F SNV - Green Mango for Better Livelihoods in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: By fostering market access, creating livelihood opportunities, and promoting inclusive growth, it drives economic development and prosperity in mango-producing communities. Through adoption of sustainable agricultural practices, efficient resource management, and waste reduction initiatives, it champions environmental stewardship and preserves natural ecosystems. Also, by empowering local stakeholders, it strengthens social cohesion and resilience. With extensive experience in the nuts, dried fruits and seed business, we can support customers and suppliers in further developing their business. Our goal is to be the shortest link to the origin, prioritizing efficiency over unnecessary trading. Instead of maximizing profits, we represent suppliers we believe in, working on a fixed commission percentage. Our target is to achieve a sales value of 75-100 million euros (not turnover!) with a gross profit of over 2 million euros and a net profit of 350-500K euros. We operate at the top of the supply chain, offering added value through our experience with products, suppliers, and regulations.
